title: 2018 AMC 12B Problem 23
statement: Ajay is standing at point \(A\) near Pontianak, Indonesia, \(0^\circ\) latitude and \(110^\circ\) E longitude. Billy is standing at point \(B\) near Big Baldy Mountain, Idaho, USA, \(45^\circ\) N latitude and \(115^\circ\) W longitude. Assume that Earth is a perfect sphere with center \(C.\) What is the degree measure of \(\angle ACB?\)

solutions.text:
The longitudes differ by \(360^\circ-(110^\circ+115^\circ)=135^\circ,\) and \(B\) is at latitude \(45^\circ\) N. Place \(A=(1,0,0)\) on the unit sphere.

Then \(B=\tiny\left(\cos45^\circ\cos135^\circ,\ \cos45^\circ\sin135^\circ,\ \sin45^\circ\right)\) \(=\left(-\tfrac12,\tfrac12,\tfrac{\sqrt2}{2}\right).\) The dot product is \(A\cdot B=-\tfrac12,\) so \(\cos\angle ACB=-\tfrac12\) and \(\angle ACB=120^\circ.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Put both points on a unit sphere and take the dot product of their position vectors
